name: Combobox
hint: Type a few letters. The rows that stay slide up into place, the typed part is underlined, and the highlight rides with the first match.
description: Searchable dropdown field: type to filter a long list and pick from it, or type free text with suggestions (autocomplete). For an assignee among hundreds of people, a city, an airport, an email domain. At rest it matches Text Field and Select (label floating or above, hint and error line, focus ring); its popup is Select's. As you type the list re-forms: rows that stay slide to their new places on a spring, rows that leave fade where they were, the popup's height springs to fit, the highlight travels with the first match, and the typed part of each label is underlined as it is typed. Accent- and case-insensitive matching at the start of words, grouped options, descriptions and avatars, multiple choice as chips, create-from-text, server-side search with a loading state, and an empty state that names the query. Keyboard and screen-reader behaviour (combobox and listbox roles, arrows, Enter, Escape, active-descendant) come from the @base-ui/react package.
intents: searchable dropdown to type and filter a long list
pick an assignee or a person by typing a name
type ahead select with server side search
multi select with search and chips
create a new option from what was typed
usage: Use when people choose from a list by typing: an assignee among hundreds, a city, an airport, a tag. Pick mode (default): pass `options` (strings, `{ value, label, description, icon, disabled, keywords }`, or groups `{ label, options }`, the same shape as Select, so you can switch by changing the tag), a `label`, `name` for forms, and `value` + `onChange(value, option, event)` or `defaultValue`. Typing filters; leaving without picking puts the last chosen label back; an emptied input clears the value when the field is left. Suggest mode (`allowCustom`): the value is the text (`value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(text, option | null, event)`) and the list only suggests; nothing is highlighted until the arrow keys move, so Enter keeps what was typed. `multiple` (pick mode) keeps the popup open after each pick and shows chips; `onChange(values, { value, selected, option }, event)`. `creatable` adds a "Create …" row when nothing matches exactly and calls `onCreate(text, event)`; the value becomes the text. Matching is accent- and case-insensitive at the start of any word in the label or `keywords`; `filter(option, query)` replaces it and `filter={false}` turns client filtering off for server-side search: control `inputValue` / `onInputChange(text, event)`, set `loading` while you fetch (earlier results stay, dimmed), and pass the results as `options`. `minChars` keeps the list closed until enough is typed. `openOnFocus` (default) opens the list on a click or tap in the field; focus from the Tab key does not open it, the arrow keys or typing do. Keys: ArrowDown / ArrowUp move through the list, Enter picks, Escape closes, a second Escape clears only with `clearable`, Home / End and the left and right arrows move the caret in the text, Tab leaves without picking, Backspace in an empty input removes the last chip. Do not use it for a short list that needs no typing (use Select), two to five visible choices (Segmented Control or Radio Group), many free-form tags (Tag Input), or app commands (Command Palette). `error` shows a message you already have; `required` blocks an empty submit and focuses the input; bump `revealErrors` on every submit. The popup renders through the kit's layer: it keeps the theme, is never clipped, counts as inside a Modal or Popover, and does not lock page scroll. The ref and unknown props (aria-*, data-*) go to the <input>. Keyboard and screen-reader behaviour come from the @base-ui/react package (install it beside motion).

keyboard.does: Moves focus to the text input; the chevron button is skipped, and the list stays closed until you type or press an arrow.
Types into the input, opens the list and filters it to the options that match; the first match is highlighted.
Opens the list, or moves the highlight to the next or previous option while focus stays in the input.
Move the caret to the start or end of the text.
Chooses the highlighted option, puts its label in the input and closes the list; a disabled option is not chosen.
Adds the highlighted option as a chip and keeps the list open for the next one.
Closes the list and puts back the chosen option's label; a second press on a closed field clears it only when it is clearable.
Moves focus from an empty input into the chips and between them, and back to the input.
Removes the focused chip; Backspace in an empty input removes the last chip.
Clears the field and returns focus to the input.

screenReader: The input is a combobox with aria-expanded and aria-autocomplete="list", named by `label` (pass `aria-label` when there is none) and described by `hint` or the error; an error sets aria-invalid. The highlighted option is announced through aria-activedescendant while focus stays in the input; a polite status says the number of results once typing settles, "No results for …" when nothing matches, and the `labels.loading` text while `loading` (the list is aria-busy). Chips are named by their label and each remove button by `labels.remove`; the clear and chevron buttons are named by `labels.clear` and `labels.toggle`.

dataProps.description: Strings, { value, label, description?, icon?, disabled?, keywords? } objects, or groups { label, options: [...] }. A string s is short for { value: s, label: s }. keywords are extra words that match but are not shown.
Controlled value: an option's value (pick), an array of values (multiple), or the text (allowCustom). Pass it with onChange.
Starting value when uncontrolled; also what a form reset returns to.

dataProps.type: (value: string | number | null | Array<string | number>, detail: { value: string | number; label?: node; description?: node; icon?: node; disabled?: boolean; keywords?: Array<string> } | null | { value: string | number; selected: boolean; option: { value: string | number; label?: node; description?: node; icon?: node; disabled?: boolean; keywords?: Array<string> } | null }, event?: Event) => void
dataProps.description: (value, option, event) => void; with multiple (values, { value, selected, option }, event); with allowCustom (text, option | null, event) on every change of the text. Also fires on clear, create and a form reset that changes the value.
Controlled text in the input (for server-side search). Pass it with onInputChange.
Starting text when the text is uncontrolled. Defaults to the chosen option's label (pick) or defaultValue (allowCustom).
(text, event) => void, on every change of the text, including the label put back after a pick. Debounce in your own code.
Controlled open state. Pass it with onOpenChange.
Open on first render when uncontrolled.
(open, reason, event) => void. reason: typing, input, trigger, keyboard, select, escape, outside, blur, clear, other.
(text, event) => void, when the "Create …" row is picked (with creatable). Add the option to your list; the value becomes the text.

dataProps.type: ((option: { value: string | number; label?: node; description?: node; icon?: node; disabled?: boolean; keywords?: Array<string> }, query: string) => boolean) | false
dataProps.description: (option, query) => boolean to replace the matching, or false to show options as given (server-side search). The typed part is still marked when it can be found.
An error you already have; shown under the field, announced, and the field shakes once when it arrives.
Bump on every submit: the field marks itself touched, shows the required message if empty, and shakes.
Form field name. Pick mode submits the option's value (one entry per value with multiple); allowCustom submits the text.
Id for the <input>.
The input's autocomplete attribute. "off" keeps the browser's own autofill list from covering the popup.

dataProps.type: Partial<{ clear: string | (() => string); toggle: string | (() => string); empty: string | ((query: string) => string); none: string | (() => string); create: string | ((query: string) => string); loading: string | (() => string); remove: string | ((option: { value: string | number; label?: node; description?: node; icon?: node; disabled?: boolean; keywords?: Array<string> }) => string); required: string; results: string | ((count: number, formatted: string, plural: string) => string) }>
dataProps.description: Copy, each a string or a function: { clear: "Clear", toggle: "Show options", empty: "No results for “{query}”", none: "No options", create: "Create “{query}”", loading: "Loading options", remove: "Remove {label}", required: "Choose an option", results: (count, formatted) => "3 results" }.

dataProps.type: (option: { value: string | number; label?: node; description?: node; icon?: node; disabled?: boolean; keywords?: Array<string> }, state: { selected: boolean; highlighted: boolean; disabled: boolean; query: string }) => node
dataProps.description: (option, { selected, highlighted, disabled, query }) => node, the content of one row (the tick, keyboard and screen-reader behaviour stay).

dataProps.type: (option: { value: string | number; label?: node; description?: node; icon?: node; disabled?: boolean; keywords?: Array<string> }) => node
dataProps.description: (option) => node, a chip's content with multiple. In single pick mode the input shows the label as text.
Goes to the <input>, for focus().
